title: Ask HN: Where to Work After 40?
guide_zh: 四十岁创业失败后重新找工作，该去哪里寻找适合自己的职业机会？
author: asim
excerpt: I turned 40 last month and spent the past decade working on my own startup that ultimately failed. I'm now trying to figure out the next step. Someone once said to me, Google is the place you go to retire after 40. I've done my time at various startups, and spent some time at Google. As an engineer the landscape of things is always changing and we've now moved from Cloud to AI pretty rapidly. I'm just curious to know what moves people made after 40 and what worked for them.
